messages.text: Hi Sam! I'm an AI assistant working with Jordan at Maya Coaching. I'm not a person. I'll ask a few short questions so Jordan can prepare for your call, and you can ask me anything about the program. To start: what made you book a call now?
I lost two big clients this spring and my income has been up and down ever since. I can't keep guessing where next month's rent comes from.
That sounds really stressful to deal with, Sam. What have you already tried so far to bring in new steady clients?
I bought an online marketing course last year for about $500 but never finished it, and I've mostly relied on referrals. How much does your program cost?

The 90-Day Momentum Program is $3,000 paid up front, or three monthly payments of $1,100. It sounds like relying only on referrals has been tough to scale. Besides yourself, is anyone else involved in making decisions about your business?
No, it's just me. I run the business on my own, so the decision is mine. Is there a refund if it doesn't work out?

Jordan will cover refund policies directly with you on the call. Thanks for letting me know you make the decisions solo. Looking ahead, what specific result would make this program completely worth it for you?
If I had three steady retainer clients by the end of the quarter, that would make it worth it. That would cover my basics every month.

Having three steady retainer clients to cover your basics sounds like a clear, solid target. If you and Jordan decide this program is a good fit during your call, how soon are you looking to get started?
I'd want to start within the next two weeks. I can put in about five hours a week on top of client work.
Thank you for sharing all of that, Sam! Jordan will read a summary of our conversation before your call so you can jump right in.

summary_lines: Sam is a solo business owner seeking three steady retainer clients to establish predictable business income.
Lost two major clients this spring and needs a proactive way to get clients beyond relying solely on referrals.
Sole decision maker who wants to start within two weeks and can dedicate five hours a week.
